title: Method of and apparatus for processing vacuum pressure information

features.quote: Then, the value Ph is set as the failure prediction/recognition/precognition value which can be, for example, 20% of the normal maximum vacuum, and stored in EE(E 2 )PROM 32.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention a rechargeable battery or its integration into a rigid body to power a vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference mentions a digital display unit and other display units on the detecting unit, which is part of the vacuum control apparatus, but does not explicitly state it's for visibility during a lifting operation or on a handheld device.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum control apparatus, not a single-hand portable design without external hoses or cords.
